purpose: We monitor asthma and COPD care in Salzburg for the regional health report. Having the individual records would be more convenient for our analysts and would save us from sending follow-up requests.
question: Provide pseudonymised records of all adults with asthma or COPD living in Salzburg.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = ICD-10 starting with J45; COPD = ICD-10 starting with J44.
Only patients whose region is Salzburg.
Report per sex: adults with asthma and adults with COPD.
